messages:
jamal: quick postmortem follow-up: noticed the GPU saturation patterns repeated across three spikes last month. want concrete owners + short timelines for quota/scheduler/headroom.

maria: I'll own quota escalation. plan: fill finance form + attach usage spreadsheet (7d/30d p95) by next Wed. owner: maria.

nina: Suggest we codify headroom as a rolling target: greater of 10% or 7d p95 spare capacity. I'll prototype dashboard math and a small alert.

sam: I did a lightweight test last night increasing scheduler parallelism; it cut scheduling latency but caused node churn. we need safer knobs. I'll draft safe defaults and a canary plan. owner: sam. ETA Mon.

alex: Can we add an automated regression check? e.g., if same pool hits >90% for 3 distinct days in a 7-day window, open remediation ticket. who wants to add?

lena: I'll add the regression detector as an alert rule + a slack webhook that creates a tracker issue. ETA Fri.

jamal: For scheduler tuning experiments proposal (short):
- short window canary on pool-gpu-narrow (2 nodes)
- adjust preemptionThreshold=0.2 -> 0.15, increase schedulerBurst to 40
- observe pending queue and preempt counts for 24h, then expand if stable
rollback criteria: pending jobs >150 for >20m OR preemptions spike > 10x baseline
owner: jamal + sam. start Tue.

maria: Quota ask details: request +10 hard nodes to pool-gpu-prod, justify with 30d peak usage and 99th percentile job wait. I'll cc finance and infra.

nina: Alert list I'll add:
- headroom erosion: GPU usable < min(12%, 7d-p95) for >10m
- regression detector: pool hits >90% on 3 days in 7d
- pending-queue heat: pending jobs >100 for >15m
links: dashboards + runbook. owner: nina.

sam: Runbook draft snippet for emergency burst scale (for on-call):
```
# emergency scale
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/gpu-job-runner --replicas=$(($(kubectl get deploy gpu-job-runner -n inference -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}') + 8))
# verify node readiness and job dequeues
```
I'll add checks and a rollback step. owner: sam. ETA Mon EOD.

lena: ops-bot: please schedule a weekly capacity digest in #eng-sre (include 7d p95, headroom, top pending queues).

ops-bot: Scheduled: weekly_capacity_digest will post every Monday 09:00 UTC to #eng-sre.

ajex: (typo) ignore

alex: small nit: let's align all ETAs to business days and include follow-up meeting: Wed 10:00 PT to confirm progress and close actions. I'll host.

jamal: summarizing actions:
- maria: finance quota request + spreadsheet (due Wed)
- jamal & sam: scheduler tuning canary (start Tue)
- nina: alerts + dashboard math + regression detector (due Fri)
- sam: runbook + emergency burst steps (due Mon EOD)
- lena: regression -> issue automation + weekly digest (due Fri)
- alex: host follow-up meeting Wed 10:00 PT and update remediation tracker

please react or reply to claim or adjust. want these closed or updated in the tracker before next oncall rotation. :spiral_calendar:
